PORTAL_SLOT_16:
1. Open your company's Google Sites portal.
  2. Click the Insert tab on the right sidebar and select Embed.
  3. Select By URL and paste the copied Apps Script Web App URL.
  4. Choose Full Page Embed so FLINK fills the entire window seamlessly.
  5. Click Publish on Google Sites.
  6. Return here and click [ I HAVE DONE THIS ] to continue software setup.
